exposure: Transvaginal sonography (TVS) measurement of lower uterine segment cesarean scar thickness
outcome: Correlation between TVS-measured and intraoperatively measured scar thickness
cohort: 100 pregnant women at term with a history of previous LSCS scheduled for elective LSCS
finding: TVS measurement of LSCS scar thickness correlated significantly with intraoperative measurements and was related to maternal age, pre-pregnancy weight, number of previous LSCSs, and gestational age.
